decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - The proposed conversion into a large HMO (sui generis) would result in the loss of a dwelling with less than 130sq.m. floorspace (as originally constructed) which is suitable for occupation by families, as defined in Part A of Wandsworth Local Plan policy LP26. Accordingly, the development would result in harm to the provision of family housing within the borough and is contrary to Part A of LP26 and parts A.1 of policy LP29 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023). 
Reason : 2 - The proposed extensions by reason of the scale and design would result in extensions that are overly dominant, bulky, out of keeping and incongruous causing harm to the character and appearance of the property and the surrounding area. The proposal therefore fails to comply with policies LP1, LP2 and LP5 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the Housing SPD.
Reason : 3 - The proposed extensions by reason of their location, scale and design result in an imposing, overdevelopment of the property leading to a sense of enclosure, loss of light and outlook to neighbouring properties. The proposal therefore fails to comply with policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).
Reason : 4 - The development would result in insufficient and substandard waste provision for the proposed occupiers with the potential for attracting vermin and pests and contributing to waste across public spaces. The proposal therefore fails to comply with policies LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan and the Reuse, Recycling and Waste SPD (2025). 
Reason : 5 - The site has a moderate public transport accessibility level (PTAL) of 3 which 
falls short of a PTAL of at least 4 as required by part A.4. of policy LP29 which ensures shared facilities are located in well-connected locations. Accordingly, the development is contrary to policy LP29 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023). 
Reason : 6 - The proposal provides insufficent information in relation to flooding, light, sustainability, biodiversity, trees and therefore these elements cannot be fully considered within this application. The proposal therefore fails to comply with policies LP1, LP2, LP10, LP12, LP55 and LP56 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).
Reason : 7 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
description: Erection of part single, part two-storey rear extension, rear roof extensions over back addition and replacement of rear roof extensions over main roof, in conjunction with change of use to large HMO (sui generis) together with other external alterations.
